title: Retrospective Chart Review Study of Pediatric Patients Treated With Korlym for Cushing Syndrome
brief_summary: This retrospective, multi-center, chart review study will collect patient data from medical charts of pediatric patients who have been treated with Korlym for Cushing's syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pediatrics (age≤21 years) at time Korlym initiation
* Considered to have a diagnosis of endogenous Cushing's syndrome by the healthcare provider
* Received at least one dose of Korlym
* Availability of pre-treatment (baseline) and follow-up data

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: Pediatric patients who have been treated with Korlym for Cushing's syndrome
